assessments.technical_explanation: The flagged lines are inside a fenced shell example in the German installation guide. The example documents fetching the project's own installer script from its official website over HTTPS and piping the stream directly into a shell on the user's own server. This is the disclosed, user-initiated VPS installation procedure and matches the identical command published in the project README. The file is documentation, not shipped executable code; nothing executes unless a reader manually copies the command. Destination, timing, and purpose are visible and proportionate to the project's stated distribution model. The supplied evidence shows no third-party endpoint, obfuscation, concealed execution, attacker-controlled input, or script content at all, so the scanner hit reflects a documented install pattern rather than demonstrated exposure.
